subject.title: gateway: webchat clients can branch another session checkpoint

question: Should checkpoint branching remain an operator recovery capability for trusted Control UI and non-webchat clients while external webchat clients are rejected, or should every branch require admin scope?
rationale: The reported path exposes transcript-bearing session state, but the feature intentionally used operator branch and restricted restore semantics, and the existing webchat predicate has previously overblocked the Control UI; repository history cannot choose that trust boundary safely.

options.title: Preserve trusted operator branching
options.body: Reject external webchat clients and enforce source-session access while retaining operator.write for authenticated Control UI and other trusted operator clients.

options.title: Require admin branching
options.body: Make branch admin-only and document the loss of operator-level checkpoint recovery as an intentional security hardening decision.

options.title: Deny all webchat mode
options.body: Apply the existing mode-based guard uniformly, accepting that Control UI branching may remain unavailable until its connection classification changes.

recommendation.title: Preserve trusted operator branching
recommendation.body: Reject external webchat clients and enforce source-session access while retaining operator.write for authenticated Control UI and other trusted operator clients.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the checkpoint RPC surface and the operator-branch versus restricted-restore contract that this decision would revise.
